text:
Alex: Heads-up — we're cutting a coordinated py/ts release tonight during the 00:00-01:00 UTC change window. Need a quick decision on pin strategy for the breaking auth shim.
Priya: Thanks. Is this the one that touched the signer API? Any opt-outs for existing users?
Alex: Yes, new signer surface is opt-in. But we need to pin the new package on dist-tag 'next' and keep 'latest' pointing to the old patch until we finish docs and migration notes. Plan: canary -> next -> GA after 48h.
Sam: Sounds fine. What about pip? We usually use the same pattern with a temporary 'beta' tag and a yanked wheel if rollback needed.
Jordan: For npm we can use dist-tag "next" and then move to "latest" on GA. We'll also publish a migration snippet in the release notes telling users to switch to `Client(signed=true)`.
Alex: deploy-bot: request deploy-check for py wheel and npm package.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checks queued.
deploy-bot: py wheel checksum ok, wheel signatures present.
deploy-bot: npm package size OK, integrity matches.
Priya: Two ops asks: 1) add a short deprecation blurb for the old `AuthManager` usage in the release notes. 2) Add a temporary pin rollout guide for customers on Dedicated.
Sam: I'll draft the release note blurb. For Dedicated customers we should expose an explainable warning flag `--allow-legacy-auth` in the next agent so they can opt-in for 7 days.
Jordan: If we do `--allow-legacy-auth` we must add a runtime diagnostics metric so we can alert if usage > 1% after 72h. Ops needs a threshold for rollback.
Alex: Agreed. Rollback criteria proposal: revert npm dist-tag to previous and yank new pip wheel if we see >3% error rate or >200 customers failing migration in 24h. Otherwise postpone revert and open a customer support sweep.
Priya: Also add the SDK changelog entry and a migration guide snippet: 
```
# python
from redwood import Client
# old
c = Client(auth=AuthManager())
# new
c = Client(auth=Signer())
```
Sam: minor nit — include the exact `pip install` commands: `pip install redwood==2.4.0rc1 --pre` for beta; npm `npm i @redwood/sdk@next`.
Jordan: Release-bot: tag the PRs for docs and changelog.
release-bot: release-bot: docs PR #482 tagged, changelog PR #483 tagged, release notes draft created at /docs/releases/2.4.0-draft.md
Priya: One operational ask — can we set the deploy-bot flag `--quiet-window` for logs to avoid noisy alerts during rollout? We'll still keep critical alerts.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: quiet-window enabled between 00:00-01:00 UTC for non-critical alerts.
Alex: OK — final checklist: publish py wheel to beta, npm to next, update release notes with migration + deprecation notice, add Dedicated pin opt-in and metric, set rollback criteria. Sam/ Jordan handle publish; Priya+Alex approve notes.
Sam: I'm kicking off the publish in ~10m. I'll paste publish commands when done.
Jordan: I'll push the dist-tag switches right after the wheel publish completes.
Priya: I'll polish the release notes now and add the deprecation copy.
Alex: Thanks everyone. If anything unexpected, call revert: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.3.5 latest` and `twine yank redwood==2.4.0rc1` — keep me in the loop. :thumbsup:
Sam: publish done — npm pushed, py wheel uploaded to test.pypi (followup to promote to pypi after smoke tests). Logs: `publish: success (test)`, smoke tests queued.
Jordan: dist-tag set to 'next' on npm. Waiting for smoke.
Priya: Release notes updated and attached.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: smoke tests passed for canonical flows.
Alex: Promoting to GA will wait 48h as discussed. We'll monitor metrics and reconvene in 24h. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
